title: wio-e5 firmware derive_iid uses raw seed bytes, not SHA-512(pubkey) (spec 8.5/8.7 IID MUST)
description:
Requirement R-06-014 (spec-coverage matrix docs/spec-coverage/06-security-part1.md): IID = SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with iid[0] &= 0b1111_1101; MUST be SHA-512, not SHA-256.

Classification: divergent (bringup-only firmware).

Evidence: rust/lichen-firmware/wio-e5/src/main.rs:33-39 — derive_iid copies raw seed[0:8] and clears U/L bit, never hashes the pubkey. The ponytail comment misstates the upgrade path: 'real impl uses SHA256' — the canonical derivation is SHA-512(pubkey) at rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:86-92 (iid_from_pubkey_bytes), which is no_std and matches test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json.

Impact: a future flash of this firmware would derive an IID incompatible with all other stacks and with the canonical vectors; the stale comment invites a wrong 'fix' to SHA-256.

Suggested placement: wio-e5 main.rs should call lichen_core::addr::iid_from_pubkey_bytes (lichen-core is already a dependency via NodeId import at main.rs:23); replace the hardcoded seed with flash-backed storage per the existing TODO. Correct the ponytail comment to SHA-512(pubkey) even if the code fix is deferred. Also flagged in docs/spec-coverage/06-security-part1-flagged.md A16.
